name: vllm_marlin_int4_fp8_preprocess
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_marlin_int4_fp8_preprocess.py. Preprocesses packed int4 GPTQ weights for the Marlin int4-fp8 path: qweight (K//8, N) int32 (pack_factor=8), with qzeros_or_none=None and inplace=False (test defaults). qweight is random int32 built by gen_inputs to match the test's 0..2**31 range exactly. Reference calls _custom_ops.marlin_int4_fp8_preprocess(qweight, None, False) and returns the new tensor; full int32 output compared exactly by the default comparator. Requires vLLM at eval time.
